 <h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Restaurante</h2> </div>

 <section class="elementor-section elementor-top-section elementor-element elementor-element-9660122 elementor-hidden-tablet elementor-hidden-mobile elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default wpr-particle-no wpr-jarallax-no wpr-parallax-no wpr-sticky-section-no wpr-column-slider-no wpr-equal-height-no" data-id="9660122" data-element_type="section" data-e-type="section">

 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-21d8e58 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="21d8e58" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
 <h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Touros - Rio <br> Grande do Norte</h2> </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-9aa6670 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="9aa6670" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
 <p>Uma localização estratégica no litoral do RN.</p> </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-60e0779 elementor-widget-divider--view-line elementor-widget elementor-widget-divider" data-id="60e0779" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="divider.default">
 <div class="elementor-divider">
 <span class="elementor-divider-separator">
 </span>
 </div>
 </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-7639569 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="7639569" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
 <p data-start="324" data-end="617">Touros, no litoral do Rio Grande do Norte, é um destino ideal para quem busca praias bonitas, tranquilas e contato com a natureza. A cidade fica próxima de São Miguel do Gostoso e a poucas horas de carro de Natal, capital do RN, o que facilita o acesso e amplia as opções de passeio na região.</p><p data-start="619" data-end="815">Além disso, Touros é conhecida pelas excelentes condições para a prática de kitesurf, com ventos fortes e constantes durante cerca de 10 dos 12 meses do ano, atraindo praticantes de todo o Brasil.</p> </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-589a525 elementor-widget elementor-widget-image" data-id="589a525" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="image.default">
 <img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="960" height="720" src="https://amigosdovento.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/2368c60e-e82e-4bac-8e25-28294f3dfc15-1024x768.jpg" class="attachment-large size-large wp-image-143" alt="" srcset="https://amigosdovento.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/2368c60e-e82e-4bac-8e25-28294f3dfc15-1024x768.jpg 1024w, https://amigosdovento.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/2368c60e-e82e-4bac-8e25-28294f3dfc15-300x225.jpg 300w, https://amigosdovento.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/2368c60e-e82e-4bac-8e25-28294f3dfc15-768x576.jpg 768w, https://amigosdovento.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/2368c60e-e82e-4bac-8e25-28294f3dfc15.jpg 1280w" sizes="(max-width: 960px) 100vw, 960px" /> </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-33d3c17 elementor-widget__width-initial elementor-absolute elementor-widget-tablet__width-initial elementor-hidden-tablet elementor-hidden-mobile elementor-widget elementor-widget-spacer" data-id="33d3c17" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-settings="{&quot;_position&quot;:&quot;absolute&quot;}" data-widget_type="spacer.default">

 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-6b330ae elementor-widget__width-initial elementor-absolute elementor-widget-tablet__width-initial elementor-hidden-tablet elementor-hidden-mobile elementor-widget elementor-widget-spacer" data-id="6b330ae" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-settings="{&quot;_position&quot;:&quot;absolute&quot;}" data-widget_type="spacer.default">

 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-136eb7c elementor-view-default elementor-widget elementor-widget-icon" data-id="136eb7c" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="icon.default">
 <div class="elementor-icon-wrapper">
 <div class="elementor-icon">
 <svg></svg> </div>

 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-6556057 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="6556057" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
 <h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Nossa Pousada</h2> </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-8042bfd elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="8042bfd" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
 <p>O Amigos do Vento Chalés &amp; Kitepoint está localizado de frente para a praia, em Touros. Aqui você encontra chalés pé na areia, kitepoint estruturado e restaurante no local, tudo em um só espaço, pensado para quem quer praticar kite, descansar e aproveitar o melhor do litoral potiguar com conforto e tranquilidade.</p> </div>
